title: Set 302

sentences.ko: 오늘 밤에 애 재우는 데 한 시간 반이 걸렸어. 잠들었나 싶어서 방에서 살금살금 나가려고 하면 매번 벌떡 일어나 앉는 거야. 그래서 결국 침대 옆 바닥에 누워 있었는데, 아무래도 내가 애보다 먼저 잠든 것 같아.
sentences.text: It took me an hour and a half to get him down tonight. Every time I thought he was out and tried to sneak out of the room, he'd sit right up again, so I ended up lying on the floor next to his bed, and I'm pretty sure I fell asleep before he did.

alts.text: Ugh, bedtime took an hour and a half tonight. Every time I tried sneaking out, he'd pop right back up, so I just lay down on the floor by his bed, and I'm pretty sure I conked out first.

Putting him to bed this evening took an hour and a half. Each time I believed he had fallen asleep and attempted to leave the room quietly, he would sit up again immediately, so I eventually lay down on the floor beside his bed, and I am fairly certain I fell asleep before he did.

sentences.note: **get him down** 은 아이를 재운다는 뜻이고, **he was out** 은 곯아떨어졌다는 말이에요. 캐주얼에 나오는 **conked out** 도 피곤해서 뻗듯이 잠든다는 뜻입니다.

sentences.ko: 어머, 이게 얼마 만이야! 그래서 요즘 어떻게 지내? 마지막으로 들었을 때는 덴버로 이사 갈까 생각 중이라고 했잖아. 결국 갔어, 아니면 아직도 고민 중이야?
sentences.text: Oh my god, it's been forever! So what's going on with you? Last I heard you were thinking about moving to Denver. Did that ever happen, or are you still on the fence?

alts.text: No way, it's been ages! What's new? Weren't you gonna move to Denver? You do it, or still going back and forth?
Goodness, it has been such a long time! How have you been? When we last spoke, you were considering a move to Denver. Did you end up moving, or are you still undecided?

sentences.note: **it's been forever** 는 정말 오랜만이라는 뜻이에요. **on the fence** 는 이쪽저쪽 정하지 못하고 망설이는 상태를 말합니다.

sentences.ko: 어제 거의 1년 만에 스피닝 수업을 갔는데, 지금 그 대가를 치르고 있어. 계단을 거의 못 내려가겠고 감기 기운까지 있는 것 같아서, 내가 너무 무리한 건지 그냥 타이밍이 안 좋은 건지 모르겠어.
sentences.text: I went to a spin class yesterday for the first time in like a year, and now I'm paying for it. I can barely get down the stairs, and I think I'm coming down with something too, so I don't know if I pushed too hard or if it's just bad timing.

alts.text: Did a spin class yesterday, first one in like a year, and man, I'm paying for it now. I can barely make it down the stairs, and I think I'm getting sick too, so I dunno if I overdid it or it's just bad timing.

Yesterday I attended a spin class for the first time in about a year, and I am now feeling the consequences. I can scarcely walk down the stairs, and I believe I am also becoming ill, so I am not sure whether I exerted myself too much or whether the timing is simply unfortunate.

sentences.note: **paying for it** 은 앞서 한 일 때문에 지금 고생한다는 뜻이에요. **coming down with something** 은 무슨 병에 걸리려고 한다, 몸살 기운이 있다는 말입니다.

sentences.ko: 아니야 엄마, 다 괜찮아. 일도 잘 되고, 밥도 잘 먹고, 잠도 잘 자. 방금 마트 갔다 와서 목소리가 피곤하게 들리는 것뿐이야. 무슨 일 있으면 내가 말할게, 알았지?
sentences.text: No, everything's fine, Mom. Work's good, I'm eating, I'm sleeping. I only sound tired because I just got back from the store, that's all. I'd tell you if something was wrong, okay?

alts.text: Mom, I'm fine, really. Work's good, I'm eating, I'm sleeping. I'm just wiped from running to the store, that's it. I'd tell you if something was up, okay?

No, everything is fine, Mom. Work is going well, and I am eating and sleeping properly. I only sound tired because I have just returned from the store. I would tell you if something were wrong, I promise.

sentences.note: **that's all** 은 별거 아니고 그게 다라고 상대를 안심시킬 때 붙이는 말이에요. **I'd tell you if** 는 만약 그렇다면 말해 줄 거라는 가정 표현입니다.
sentences.situation: 부모님 안부 전화에서 잘 지낸다고 둘러대기

sentences.ko: 있잖아, 고양이가 싱크대 밑 수납장 여는 법을 알아내서 아침마다 부엌 바닥에 물건이 잔뜩 널려 있어. 아기용 잠금장치를 사 오긴 했는데, 그것까지 뚫으면 진짜 어떻게 해야 할지 모르겠어.
sentences.text: So the cat figured out how to open the cabinet under the sink, and every morning there's stuff all over the kitchen floor. I bought those child locks, but if she gets past those too, I honestly don't know what I'm going to do.

alts.text: The cat figured out the cabinet under the sink, so every morning the kitchen floor's covered in stuff. I got those child locks, but if she beats those too, I seriously have no idea what I'm gonna do.

The cat has learned how to open the cabinet beneath the sink, and each morning there are items scattered across the kitchen floor. I have purchased child safety locks, but if she manages to get past those as well, I truly do not know what I will do.

sentences.note: **figured out** 은 방법을 알아냈다는 뜻이에요. **gets past** 는 장애물을 뚫고 지나간다는 말로, 여기서는 잠금장치를 무력화한다는 뜻입니다.

reviewed: 1번 casual 이 text 와 첫머리(Took me an hour and a half to get him...)가 거의 같아서 더 짧고 구어적인 말로 새로 썼습니다 (conked out 은 note 에 맞춰 그대로 둠).
2번 casual 이 text 의 Last I heard you were thinking about moving to Denver 를 그대로 되풀이해서 축약된 구어로 바꿨습니다.
2번 formal 의 Did that move take place 는 원어민이 말로 거의 안 쓰는 딱딱한 글투라 Did you end up moving 으로 바꿨습니다.
4번 casual 의 I just sound tired since I got back 은 since 가 '때문에'와 '그 뒤로'로 두 가지로 읽혀서 고쳤습니다.
4번 formal 의 Mother 는 미국 사람이 엄마에게 전화로 거의 쓰지 않는 호칭이라 Mom 으로 바꿨습니다.
4번 한국어 회사도 괜찮고 를 친구에게 하듯 일도 잘 되고 로 다듬었습니다.
5번 한국어 첫머리 글쎄 는 영어 So 의 느낌과 안 맞아서 있잖아 로 바꿨습니다.
